Name: Attic Pack (PIF)
Author: Sharogg
Description:
Adds a few cozy attics for PIF. You need to buy one of the doors from PIF or a decorational door to access it. Caskable.

[b]Installation[/b]
Unzip the mod and paste it into Stardew Valley's Mods folder. Requires SMAPI,
Content Patcher, PIF and Sharogg's Tilesheets. 1.6. is required.
